scopes.podcasts:submit: Submit a podcast for listing as yourself: POST /api/submit {url}. The feed is read and checked at once and waits for a reviewer; the grant's principal is recorded as the submitter.
scopes.submissions:review: See the review queue and approve or reject entries: GET /api/review, GET /api/review/{id}, POST /api/review/{id} {decision, reason}. Reviewer only.
